reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has bars of another length (bar 2, 5, 6, 8, 11), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001370 (the melody read from 001370a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. David Evans's dates (1874–1948) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Evans_(composer) (editor of the revised Church Hymnary, 1927); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001370a.nwc).
